title: Writhe
summary: WRITHE, verb transitive 1. To twist; to distort. Her mouth she writhd. 2. To twist with violence; as, to writhe the body. 3. To wrest; to distort; to torture; as, to writhe words. WRITHE, verb intrans

inlines.v: WRITHE, verb transitive 1. To twist; to distort. Her mouth she writhd. 2. To twist with violence; as, to writhe the body. 3. To wrest; to distort; to torture; as, to writhe words. WRITHE, verb intransitive To twist; to be distorted; as, to writhe with agony.
